Join Technex'25 as a Campus Ambassador and enjoy incredible incentives for your dedication and efforts: Internship Opportunities with top companies to launch your career. Discounts on Certifications and e-learning programs. Top-performing ambassadors will also receive personalized merchandise, special coupons, and access to premium content. Don t miss the chance to shine, lead, and make an impact. Apply now and become part of the Technex'25 legacy! Why Join Technex? Technex is more than a festival; it is a gateway to growth, innovation, and opportunity. Participants gain valuable insights from guest lectures by industry leaders, acquire hands-on experience through workshops, and build lasting connections. The Campus Ambassador Program adds another dimension, offering unparalleled incentives, including internships, premium subscriptions, and travel vouchers. Whether as a participant or a Campus Ambassador, Technex provides a transformative experience, leaving an indelible mark on its attendees. Join the legacy of Technex'25 and be part of a journey that celebrates the spirit of innovation and excellence. Visit technex.co.in to learn more and apply!

description: My Analytics School is hiring for the role of Social Media Manager Internship! Overview: My Analytics School is an ed-tech startup founded by IIT alumni, dedicated to providing end-to-end solutions for analytics and related job preparation. Your job is to create and run social media plans that make our name known, connect with our community, and bring in visitors, all within the world of analytics. Key Responsibilities: Social Media Plan: Make and carry out social media plans that match our marketing goals and appeal to our analytics-loving audience. Create Content: Make interesting content for social media like text, images, videos, and more, all about analytics. Talk to Our Community: Keep an eye on our social media channels, reply to comments and messages, and chat with our analytics community to build a good brand image. Ad Campaigns: Plan and run social media ads, check how they're doing, and make them better to get the most out of them in the analytics education context. Content Schedule: Keep a schedule for what to post when on social media, with a focus on our Master of Analytics Science (MAS) program. Data and Reports: Keep an eye on the numbers, make regular reports, and give us info to see how well our social media is doing and make smart decisions. Grow Our Audience: Find ways to get more people to follow us and get involved in the analytics field. Check Out the Competition: Stay updated on what's happening in the industry and what our competition is up to, so we can keep up in the analytics education world. Teamwork: Work with other folks on the marketing team, designers, and content creators to ensure our social media plans match our bigger marketing ideas. Website Ranking and SEO : Enhance the website ranking of My Analytics School (MAS) and optimise online reach through effective SEO strategies. Who We're Looking For: A degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, with a strong connection to analytics. A minimum of 1 year of social media management experience, ideally in the analytics or education sector. Proficiency in using social media management tools and analytics platforms. Creative thinking and strong writing skills that align with the field of analytics. An up-to-date knowledge of social media trends, especially in the context of analytics education. Ability to plan strategically and make data-driven decisions. Effective communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with our analytics community. Strong multitasking abilities and the capacity to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. A collaborative spirit and the ability to work as part of a team. A fundamental understanding of the analytics field, particularly in the context of our MAS program. Knowledge of good SEO practices to increase online reach. Perks: Monthly stipend is negotiable and follows industry standards. Plus, you could earn extra bonuses, including the chance to secure a full-time job offer based on your hard work and commitment.

title: Content Writing Internship
description: Binocs.Co is hiring Content Writing Interns! Responsibilities of the Intern: Researching and writing engaging and informative blog posts, social media content, and other marketing materials Conducting interviews with industry experts and writing articles based on their insights Creating content that is SEO-friendly and optimized for search engines Editing and proofreading content created by other members of the team Collaborating with the design team to create visually appealing and engaging content Keeping up-to-date with industry trends and developments to ensure our content remains relevant and informative Assisting with other marketing-related tasks as needed Requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Journalism, Communications, Marketing, or a related field Excellent written and verbal communication skills Strong research skills and the ability to create content on a variety of topics Experience with content creation and management for blogs, social media, and other marketing materials Familiarity with SEO best practices and content optimization techniques Strong attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines Passionate about the cryptocurrency industry and eager to learn more about taxation in this space About Us: At Binocs, we are building capability to comprehend the raw ledgers of different blockchains. The full information of what is happening in a blockchain transaction ledger isn't there in the raw transaction data. It needs to be rebuilt accessing the raw transaction data along with multiple other data sources like, understanding smart contracts, live pricing information of various assets and other sources. Binocs capability can be used to spawn multiple applications/ products in the crypto-verse. The first one we intend to build is one of the critical issues that the crypto verse is grappling with - regulations and compliances. Tax both at the individual level and institutional level is at the centre of this issue. We plan to launch our first product as a system to help crypto investors connect their investment accounts (exchanges and wallets etc.) to our app, which will enable us to read their raw transactions and prepare an accounting and tax ledger for them. Widespread crypto adoption in countries/ regions like India, Indonesia, Vietnam, GCC, Asian, Latin America would require government acceptance. Binocs has the opportunity to make the blockchain revolution mainstream by being a key enabler in this space. Our team strongly believes in the potential benefits of decentralization and democratization of the assets. With Binocs, we expect more users will be able to start leveraging the blockchain technology for their financial freedom. Currently, we are helping crypto investors across US, UK, IN, AU, SA who would be soon looking for a tax solution to file for taxes. We are continuously expanding our geographical reach to enable more crypto users to use our tool. This is a grand mission and it is not going to be easy. The world of crypto is ever-expansive - there are several tens of currencies, ten of thousands of coins and smart contracts, and several tens of protocols to run on them. It requires careful planning and execution of building a software that our users will love and get benefitted from. Multiple protocols and smart contracts have been built with the vision of empowering users/ investors. Complexity in the crypto ecosystem is a given. We are looking for a motivated, talented, smart set of individuals who share our vision and can make a difference. People who are not happy with the status quo, who are inherently dissatisfied and make things better. People who envision big changes, and see themselves playing a critical role in making those changes happen. People who can accept challenges and put their heart and soul into solving for those. We are looking for better versions of ourselves in this journey - who are not bogged down by titles and authority but strongly push for their data/ logic/ experience backed decisions. We are building a fast-paced core team to own and shape various aspects of the business and the technology.
